source_snapshot.procedure: Enable BIOS debug/error injection, deploy ITP, halt, call ei.injectIERR(socket), resume and collect evidence.
source_snapshot.criteria: Crash/hang then eventual reboot, BMC CPU Catastrophic Error, fault light, recovered UEFI UPI fatal and optional LCD CPU Over Temp.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; preserves FAE injection boundary but proposes incomplete post-event SSH/dmesg evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; socket mapping, outage timing, IERR-versus-UPI/thermal oracle and recovery remain unresolved.

old_problem: The explicit socket stimulus is usable only after logical-to-physical mapping, while Criteria mix IERR with UPI fatal and CPU Over Temp indications and leave `eventually` unbounded.
disposition_reason: The operation and target argument are identifiable, so vendor inputs can make a controlled future run and BLOCKED is not intrinsic. ED-16 still requires an approved harness, isolated target, deterministic IERR oracle and recovery. The cross-domain UPI/thermal expectations and outage boundary affect PASS and cannot be guessed or reduced to ED-03 runtime values.
decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Reliability rows 11 and 12 with exact IERR call, Criteria and DeepSeek fields.
Read historical record 2417 and preserved exact identity and hashes.
Bind Intel logical socket numbering to the physical CPU before halt/injection.
Do not substitute a generic MCE/UPI event for the distinct internal-CPU-error stimulus.
Require platform authority for any intentional IERR-to-UPI-fatal or CPU-over-temperature display mapping.
No BIOS, ITP, injection, reset, power, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.purpose: Inject one internal CPU error into each approved physical socket and prove the bounded catastrophic outage/recovery plus consistent affected-CPU identity in all required evidence planes.
required_package: Approved Intel ITP/CScripts build/hash and injectIERR semantics
IERR/internal-error, BMC, UEFI, OS, LED and LCD event map
Independent-console recovery and BIOS restoration procedure
test_case.test_command: A qualified Intel FAE on a dedicated SUT must snapshot state, map the numeric argument to the physical CPU, invoke `ei.injectIERR(socket)` once for the approved target, record the outage on an independent timeline, wait the protected autonomous-recovery interval, capture complete IERR/internal-error and applicable physical evidence, and restore debug settings under the approved recovery plan.
test_case.expected_result: The selected CPU is unambiguously identified; the platform follows the signed crash/hang-to-autonomous-reboot timing and produces the approved IERR/internal-error, BMC/UEFI/OS and indicator response for that CPU, then returns healthy with settings restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires target proof, one-shot transcript, bounded external timeline, exact approved IERR event mapping and complete recovery/restoration. Generic machine-check text, unexplained UPI/thermal evidence, indefinite hang, intervention inside the protected window, missing affected-CPU identity or failed restoration is not PASS.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle SUT, stable power, independent console and intentional-crash approval.
Preserve logs/settings and verify the numeric socket before injection.
Do not reset or power-cycle during the protected recovery interval.
No auto-retry; escalate wrong target, thermal/power anomaly, timeout or no-boot.
expected_evidence: Harness hash, socket mapping and complete ITP transcript
IERR/internal-error OS/console, BMC catastrophic and corrected UEFI evidence
LED/LCD affected-CPU evidence with event-map authority
Recovery, BIOS restoration, health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: After the full approved autonomous-reboot interval, preserve evidence and allow only the qualified owner to select the documented recovery transition. Verify injector inactivity, health and every BIOS setting before any next socket or rerun.

source_conflict.reason: IERR stimulus versus UPI-fatal/CPU-over-temperature acceptance and unbounded `eventually` remain unresolved.

blocked.reason: The socket-scoped IERR operation is identifiable; execution is conditional on vendor package, deterministic oracle, timers and recovery.
